sloka: ततो ऽन्यं देशमास्थाय शक्रः सन्त्यज्य रावणम् ।अयुध्यत महाराज राक्षसांस्त्रासयन्रणे ।। ७.२९.१७ ॥
transliteration: tato 'nyaṁ deśamāsthāya śakraḥ santyajya rāvaṇam ।ayudhyata mahārāja rākṣasāṁstrāsayanraṇe ।। 7.29.17 ॥

translations.english: Then, O great king, Indra, leaving Ravana, took up another position and fought, terrifying the Rakshasas in battle.
